name: Tome of Divinity
summary: Azar Stronghammer sends promising dwarven paladins from Dun Morogh to Ironforge for deeper instruction. There, Tiza Battleforge awaits in the Hall of Mysteries, where the trials begin in service to the Holy Light.

sections.title: A Call to the High Seat
sections.body: Dwarven initiates guard Dun Morogh's snowbound villages and roads. When Azar sees that a defender is ready for deeper spiritual instruction, he sends that candidate from field duties to Ironforge. There, the city's holy elders can guide them.

sections.title: The Hall of Mysteries
sections.body: The summons takes you through the Mystic Ward to the Hall of Mysteries. Sacred relics and solemn study fill its halls. Tiza Battleforge tests your readiness for self-sacrifice, mercy, and the moral duties of your calling.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: why do i need this quest
what is tome of divinity for
faq.answer: Azar Stronghammer calls a promising dwarven paladin from field duties in Dun Morogh and sends you to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge. The trials teach you about the Holy Light and are required to earn the power of resurrection.

Tiza Battleforge is a veteran dwarven paladin and respected mentor in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. She guides young paladins through spiritual instruction and the sacred trials of the Tome of Divinity.

faq.q: Where is the Hall of Mysteries located?
faq.answer: The Hall of Mysteries lies in the Mystic Ward in western Ironforge. Priests, paladins, and mages gather there, at the spiritual and arcane center of the dwarven capital.

faq.q: Who sends the paladin on this errand?
faq.answer: Azar Stronghammer, a paladin trainer in Dun Morogh, sends promising initiates to Ironforge after they prove their dedication to defending local dwarven settlements.

faq.q: Why must dwarven paladins study in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Azar teaches basic combat in the field, while the Hall of Mysteries holds the formal teachings, sacred texts, and elders of the Holy Light. Senior mentors such as Tiza Battleforge guide the study of advanced rites and spiritual doctrines.

faq.q: What follows after speaking with Tiza Battleforge?
aliases: next quest after tome of divinity
faq.answer: Speaking with Tiza begins the dwarven trials of the Tome of Divinity. They challenge you to show devotion, compassion, and sacrifice in service to the Light.

angles.text: As a paladin, you join practical military service in the snows with the deep spiritual discipline expected of a holy warrior.
As a dwarf, you join your kin's endurance with the teachings of the Holy Light in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries.
As an Alliance member, you share reverence for the Light with dwarven defenders of Khaz Modan and your human allies in Lordaeron and Stormwind.
